meta.name: Divine Glories
meta.outline: Verses 1–7: Krishna is the unborn source of the gods, the sages and every quality found in beings; 8–11: how the wise worship him, and what he gives them; 12–18: Arjuna accepts this and asks to hear his glories; 19–38: “Among these, I am this”, the best of every kind; 39–42: nothing exists without him, and all of it is one small part of him.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः
verses.tr: Krishna said: Arjuna, listen once more to my highest teaching. I shall tell it to you because you delight in it and because I wish you well.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः
words: of the gods and the great sages
verses.tr: Neither the hosts of gods nor the great sages know my origin, for I am the source of the gods and the great sages in every way.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: the great Lord of the worlds
verses.tr: Whoever knows me as unborn and without beginning, the great Lord of the worlds, is undeluded among mortals and is freed from all wrongs.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च
verses.tr: Intelligence, knowledge, freedom from delusion, forgiveness, truthfulness, self-control and calmness; pleasure and pain, birth and death, fear and fearlessness;

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः
verses.tr: non-violence, even-mindedness, contentment, self-discipline, giving, fame and ill fame: all these different states of beings come from me alone.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः
words: from whom all the people in the world have come
verses.tr: The seven great sages, the four who came before them, and the Manus all have my nature and were born from my mind. From them have come all the people of the world.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
words: this glory and power of mine
is united with me in unshakeable yoga
there is no doubt of this
verses.tr: Whoever truly knows this glory and power of mine is united with me in a yoga that cannot be shaken. There is no doubt of this.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः
words: I am the source of all
verses.tr: I am the source of all, and everything proceeds from me. Knowing this, the wise worship me with all their heart.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च
words: with their lives given to me
they are content and full of joy
verses.tr: With their minds on me and their lives given to me, teaching one another and always speaking of me, they are content and full of joy.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते
words: to those who are always united with me
I give that yoga of understanding
by which they come to me
verses.tr: To those who are always united with me and worship me with love, I give the understanding by which they come to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: with the shining lamp of knowledge
verses.tr: Out of compassion for them, I live in their hearts and destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the shining lamp of knowledge.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
skt: परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्
verses.tr: Arjuna said: You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme home and the supreme purifier. The eternal divine Person, the first of the gods, unborn and present everywhere:

verses.speaker: Arjuna
skt: असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे
words: so all the sages call you
and you yourself tell me so
verses.tr: this is what all the sages call you, and the divine sage Narada, and Asita, Devala and Vyasa. And now you yourself tell me so.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
skt: न हि ते भगवन् व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः
words: I hold all this to be true
न हि ते भगवन् व्यक्तिं विदुः
for, Lord, they do not know your true form
neither the gods nor the demons
verses.tr: I hold all that you tell me to be true, Krishna. Neither the gods nor the demons, Lord, know your true form.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
words: स्वयम् एव आत्मना आत्मानं वेत्थ त्वम्
you alone know yourself by yourself
verses.tr: You alone know yourself by yourself, O Supreme Person, source of all beings, Lord of beings, God of gods, Lord of the world.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
words: you fill these worlds and remain in them
verses.tr: Please tell me in full of your divine glories, the glories by which you fill these worlds and live in them.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
skt: केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया
words: you, by always thinking of you
are you to be thought of
verses.tr: Master of yoga, how may I come to know you by always thinking of you? In which forms, Lord, should I think of you?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
skt: भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि शृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम्
verses.tr: Tell me again, Krishna, in detail, of your power and your glory. I can never hear enough of your words, which are like nectar.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: very well, I shall tell you
for there is no end to my extent
verses.tr: Krishna said: Very well. I shall tell you of my divine glories, Arjuna, but only the chief ones, for there is no end to them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च
words: seated in the heart of all beings
I am the beginning and the middle
and also the end of beings
verses.tr: Arjuna, I am the Self seated in the heart of all beings. I am the beginning, the middle and the end of all beings.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: among the Adityas I am Vishnu
among the Maruts (storm gods) I am Marichi
among the stars I am the moon
verses.tr: Among the Adityas I am Vishnu; among lights, the radiant sun. Among the storm gods I am Marichi; among the stars of the night, I am the moon.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of the Vedas I am the Sama Veda
of the gods I am Indra
of the senses I am the mind
in living beings I am consciousness
verses.tr: Of the Vedas I am the Sama Veda; of the gods I am Indra. Of the senses I am the mind; in living beings I am consciousness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of the Rudras I am Shankara (Shiva)
of the yakshas and rakshasas, Kubera, lord of wealth
of the Vasus I am fire
of mountain peaks I am Meru
verses.tr: Of the Rudras I am Shiva; of the yakshas and rakshasas I am Kubera, lord of wealth. Of the Vasus I am fire; of mountain peaks I am Meru.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्
words: know me as the chief of priests
of army commanders I am Skanda (Kartikeya)
of waters I am the ocean
verses.tr: Know me, Arjuna, as Brihaspati, the chief of priests. Of army commanders I am Skanda; of all waters I am the ocean.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of the great sages I am Bhrigu
of words I am the one syllable (Om)
of sacrifices I am japa, the quiet repetition of the holy name
of things that do not move, the Himalaya
verses.tr: Of the great sages I am Bhrigu; of words I am the one syllable Om. Of sacrifices I am japa, the quiet repetition of the holy name; of things that do not move, I am the Himalaya.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of all trees, the sacred fig (peepal)
of the perfected, the sage Kapila
verses.tr: Of all trees I am the peepal; of the divine sages, Narada. Of the heavenly musicians I am Chitraratha; of the perfected ones, the sage Kapila.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Of horses, know me to be Ucchaihshravas, who rose from the churning for nectar. Of lordly elephants I am Airavata, and among people I am the king.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of weapons I am the thunderbolt
of cows I am Kamadhenu, who grants wishes
I am Kandarpa, the god of love, the cause of birth
verses.tr: Of weapons I am the thunderbolt; of cows I am Kamadhenu, who grants every wish. I am Kandarpa, the god of love, through whom children are born; of serpents I am Vasuki.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of the nagas I am Ananta
of water beings I am Varuna
of the ancestors I am Aryama
of those who keep order I am Yama
verses.tr: Of the nagas I am Ananta; of the beings of the water I am Varuna. Of the ancestors I am Aryama; of those who keep order I am Yama.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of the daityas I am Prahlada
of those who measure I am time
of animals I am the lion, their king
and of birds, Garuda, son of Vinata
verses.tr: Of the daityas I am Prahlada; of all that measures, I am time. Of animals I am the lion, and of birds I am Garuda.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of purifiers I am the wind
of those who bear weapons I am Rama
of fishes I am the makara, the great sea creature
of rivers I am the Ganga
verses.tr: Of purifiers I am the wind; of those who bear weapons I am Rama. Of the creatures of the water I am the makara; of rivers I am the Ganga.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of creations I am the beginning and the end
of all knowledge, the knowledge of the Self
of those who debate, I am honest reasoning
verses.tr: Of all creations I am the beginning, the middle and the end, Arjuna. Of all kinds of knowledge I am the knowledge of the Self; among those who debate, I am the reasoning that seeks the truth.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of letters I am the letter A
I am time that never ends
I am the supporter who faces every way
verses.tr: Of letters I am the letter A; of compound words I am the pair, in which both words are equal. I am time that never ends, and I am the supporter whose face is turned in every direction.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा
words: I am death, which carries off everything
and the origin of all that is yet to be
of the feminine, fame, fortune and speech
verses.tr: I am death, which carries off everything, and I am the origin of all that is yet to be. Of the feminine I am fame, fortune, speech, memory, intelligence, steadiness and forgiveness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of the Sama hymns, the Brihat Saman
of metres I am the Gayatri
of seasons, spring, the time of flowers
verses.tr: Of the Sama hymns I am the Brihat Saman; of poetic metres I am the Gayatri. Of months I am Margashirsha; of seasons I am spring, the time of flowers.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of those who cheat I am gambling
I am the brilliance of the brilliant
I am the goodness of the good
verses.tr: Of those who cheat I am the gambling; of the brilliant I am the brilliance. I am victory, I am resolve, and I am the goodness of the good.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of the Vrishnis I am Vasudeva (Krishna)
of the sages I am Vyasa
verses.tr: Of the Vrishnis I am Krishna; of the Pandavas I am Arjuna. Of the sages I am Vyasa; of poets I am the poet Ushana.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: of those who discipline I am the rod of punishment
of those who seek victory I am right conduct
I am the knowledge of those who know
verses.tr: Of those who discipline I am the rod; of those who seek victory I am right conduct. Of secrets I am silence, and I am the knowledge of those who know.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्
words: and whatever is the seed of all beings
verses.tr: And I am the seed of all beings, Arjuna. Nothing that moves or does not move could exist without me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: this has been told only as a sample
of the extent of my glory, by me
verses.tr: There is no end to my divine glories, Arjuna. What I have told you is only a sample of how far they reach.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: know that every one of them
has come from a spark of my splendour
verses.tr: Whatever has glory, beauty or strength, know that it has come from a spark of my splendour.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: what use is it for you to know all this detail
I hold up this whole world
and stand, with one small part of myself
verses.tr: But what need is there for you to know all this, Arjuna? I hold up this whole world with only one small part of myself.
